characters.name: Aemeath
characters.title: Synchronist of the Exostrider
characters.notes: Aemeath is a former Exostrider Synchronist of Rabelle College who became a digital ghost after synchronizing with the Exostrider. She now sings quietly amongst the stars while remaining deeply connected to the Exostrider.

characters.name: Carlotta
characters.title: The First Daughter of the Montelli Family
characters.notes: Carlotta is the eldest daughter of the Montelli family in Ragunna City. As a member of the prestigious Montelli family, she is known for her refined appearance, artistic talent, and powerful Glacio abilities.

characters.name: Rover
characters.title: Veil of Shadows
characters.notes: The protagonist of Wuthering Waves, an amnesiac Arbiter from another world who awakens with no memory of their past. Rover can resonate with multiple attributes and adapt their combat role accordingly.

characters.name: Denia
characters.title: Bubbles of Nihility
characters.notes: A Department of Voidmatters student at Startorch Academy and a professional slacker with an observant nature. Denia is known for her gentle smile and witty personality while possessing a deeper connection to the Fractsidus.

characters.name: Baizhi
characters.title: Healing You'tan
characters.notes: A researcher at Huaxu Academy specializing in Remnant Ecoacoustics and Remnant Energy. Her companion You'tan is closely connected to her research and provides her healing abilities.

characters.name: Hiyuki
characters.title: Futures' Tithe
characters.notes: A miko of the Flaming Sakura and a member of the Special Response Force. Having served as a miko for over a century, Hiyuki possesses unusual abilities connected to Suzu, one of the Legacy Talismans left behind by the Sentinels.

stats.affiliation: Special Response Force / Spacetrek Collective / Startorch Academy

characters.name: Galbrena
characters.title: Infernal Descent
characters.notes: A formidable Discord Slayer formerly known as Angel. Galbrena hunts Tacet Discords and can consume their frequencies and powers with the aid of Chimera. She now serves as a Consultant of the Black Shores.

characters.name: Jinhsi
characters.title: Thawborn Renewal
characters.notes: The young Magistrate of Jinzhou and the appointed Resonator of Sentinel Jue. Jinhsi carries the responsibility of protecting Jinzhou and guiding its future while wielding powerful Spectro abilities.

characters.name: Phoebe
characters.title: Graceful Luminescence
characters.notes: An Acolyte of the Order of the Deep known for her warmth, grace, devotion, and self-discipline. Phoebe carries out her duties with unwavering faith and offers compassion and comfort to those around her.

characters.name: Shorekeeper
characters.title: Euphonic Chrysalis
characters.notes: The guardian of the Black Shores and a mysterious divine being who has spent eons fulfilling her role. Her encounter with Rover awakens new emotions and desires within her, leading her to form a deeper connection with the world.

characters.name: Yangyang
characters.title: Breath of Winds
characters.notes: An outrider of the Midnight Rangers who can hear and perceive the sounds of the wind. Yangyang is one of Rover's earliest companions and is known for her gentle, attentive, and considerate personality.

characters.name: Yangyang: Xuanling
characters.title: Voices of Azure Plume
characters.notes: A 5-Star variant of Yangyang known as Xuanling. This form wields Havoc power and represents a significant evolution of Yangyang's combat capabilities.

characters.name: Zhezhi
characters.title: Enchanted Brush
characters.notes: A commissioned painter known for her quiet and shy personality. Zhezhi is deeply dedicated to her craft, and her paintings are brought to life through her Resonance abilities.

characters.name: Cartethyia
characters.title: Feathered Tempest
characters.notes: A wandering knight from Rinascita formerly revered as Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden. Cartethyia carries the powers of Sentinel Imperator and Threnodian Leviathan and seeks to live freely beyond the titles and expectations placed upon her.

characters.name: Changli
characters.title: Eternal Blaze
characters.notes: The former Secretary-General of the Central Secretariat in Mingting and the current Counselor to Jinzhou Magistrate Jinhsi. Changli is a patient and calculated strategist who excels at manipulating human nature and planning several steps ahead.

characters.name: Chisa
characters.title: Eye of Unravelling
characters.notes: A conscientious and level-headed student from Startorch Academy. Chisa approaches problems analytically and believes everything can be broken down and resolved, although human bonds remain the one thing she struggles to understand.

characters.name: Hsin
characters.notes: A newly revealed Wuthering Waves character. Hsin is confirmed as a 5-Star character, but her detailed combat information, element, weapon, role, birthday, affiliation, release date, and voice actors are not yet available.

characters.name: Suisui
characters.title: Bubbles of Prosperity
characters.notes: Born into a noble family of Mingting, Suisui is the brilliant young director of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. She wields a water fan and uses her Resonance abilities to manipulate surrounding water and create graceful aquatic phenomena.

characters.name: Qingxiao
characters.title: The Sword Immortal
characters.notes: A reclusive sword immortal and nominal Cavalry Officer of the Zhenxuan Division under the Military Strategy Office of Xuanfang City. Qingxiao is renowned for her mastery of both the qin and sword and is surrounded by legends portraying her as an immortal guardian of the region.

characters.name: Lucilla
characters.title: President of Startorch Academy
characters.notes: The President of Startorch Academy and an idealist with both feet firmly on the ground. Lucilla quietly watches over her students as they strive to reach greater heights. She previously served as the editor-in-chief of an academic journal in the New Federation and worked with Mortefi.

characters.name: Aglaea
characters.title: The Goldweaver
characters.notes: The Goldweaver and Chrysos Heir bearing the Coreflame of Romance. Aglaea is a powerful Remembrance DPS who fights alongside her memosprite, Garmentmaker.

characters.name: Castorice
characters.title: Servant of Death
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir bearing the Coreflame of Death. Castorice is the daughter of the River of Souls and commands the power of life and death alongside her memosprite Netherwing.

characters.name: Cyrene
characters.title: Daughter of Aedes Elysiae
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir of Aedes Elysiae and a key figure of the Remembrance. Cyrene supports allies through powerful buffs and her unique Recollection mechanics.

characters.name: Firefly
characters.title: The Molten Knight
characters.notes: A young woman afflicted with Entropy Loss Syndrome who fights using the SAM armor. Firefly seeks a meaning for life while repeatedly confronting death through battle.

characters.name: Evanescia
characters.title: The Mysterious Lady
characters.notes: A mysterious lady who appears in Planarcadia like a fleeting season. Evanescia follows the Path of Elation and specializes in powerful Elation damage and Punchline mechanics.

characters.name: The Herta
characters.title: Madam Herta
characters.notes: The true Herta, a member of the Genius Society and the creator of the Herta Space Station. Unlike her puppet avatars, Madam Herta personally takes the field and wields overwhelming Erudition power.

characters.name: Himeko Nova
characters.title: Navigator of the Astral Express
characters.weapon: A Star That Lights the Night
characters.notes: A powerful new form of Himeko who follows the Path of Erudition. Himeko Nova specializes in Assist Skills, powerful follow-up attacks, and devastating Ultimate attacks while retaining her connection to the Astral Express.
tags: A Star That Lights the Night

characters.name: Hysilens
characters.title: Daughter of the Sea
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir of Styxia and a master of oceanic power. Hysilens follows the Path of Nihility and specializes in damage-over-time effects, applying multiple DoT types to enemies.

characters.name: Jade
characters.title: The Pave of Debt
characters.notes: A senior manager of the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Jade is an elegant and calculating moneylender who specializes in extracting value from seemingly hopeless investments.

characters.name: Jingliu
characters.title: Transcendent Flash
characters.weapon: I Shall Be My Own Sword
characters.notes: The former Sword Champion of the Xianzhou and Jing Yuan's master. Jingliu became mara-struck and now walks the path of the sword while suppressing the madness within her.
tags: I Shall Be My Own Sword

characters.name: Lingsha
characters.title: The Fragrant Smoke
characters.notes: The Vidyadhara Cauldron Master of the Xianzhou Luofu. Lingsha is a skilled healer who uses incense and her companion Fuyuan to provide healing and follow-up attacks.

characters.name: March 7th • Evernight
characters.title: Evernight
characters.notes: An alternate Remembrance form of March 7th encountered during the Amphoreus journey. Evernight is a powerful HP-scaling Remembrance damage dealer who fights alongside her memosprite.

characters.name: Phainon
characters.title: Worldbearing
characters.notes: The Chrysos Heir carrying the Coreflame of Worldbearing. Phainon is a powerful Destruction character whose Ultimate transforms the battlefield and isolates him as the primary combatant.

characters.name: Robin
characters.title: The Halovian Singer
characters.notes: A Halovian singer born in Penacony who achieved cosmic fame. Robin follows the Path of Harmony and provides powerful teamwide buffs and action advancement through her music.

characters.name: Silver Wolf • LV.999
characters.title: The Invincible Player
characters.notes: A new Elation form of Silver Wolf, presented as an invincible player who has conquered every level and Cosmic Achievement. Unlike her original Nihility form, LV.999 follows the Path of Elation and focuses on high-speed Elation damage.

characters.name: Sparkle
characters.title: Masked Fool
characters.notes: A dangerous and unpredictable member of the Masked Fools. Sparkle is a master of deception and theatrics who follows the Path of Harmony and manipulates the battlefield through powerful buffs and Skill Point mechanics.

characters.name: The Dahlia
characters.title: Constance
characters.notes: Known as Constance, The Dahlia is a powerful Nihility support focused on Break and Super Break teams. She can convert Toughness Reduction into Super Break damage and provide powerful Break-oriented debuffs.

characters.name: Tingyun • Fugue
characters.title: Fugue
characters.notes: A new form of Tingyun following the Path of Nihility. Fugue specializes in Break teams, providing Weakness manipulation, Break Effect support, and powerful debuffs against enemies.

characters.name: Yao Guang
characters.title: Seer Strategist
characters.notes: A mysterious and radical Seer Strategist associated with the Path of the Hunt. Yao Guang follows the Path of Elation and specializes in amplifying Elation teams through Zones, Punchline generation, and powerful team buffs.

characters.name: Welt
characters.title: Yang
characters.weapon: In the Name of the World
characters.notes: The former Anti-Entropy Sovereign and a veteran who has repeatedly saved Earth from destruction. Welt joined the Astral Express and continues his journey across worlds while wielding powerful Imaginary abilities.
tags: In the Name of the World

characters.name: Scarlet
characters.title: Black Blade
characters.notes: A member of the Pioneer squad and one of the legendary Grimms Models. Scarlet is a swordswoman who fights with her signature blade while sacrificing HP to greatly increase her offensive power.

characters.name: Diesel: Winter Sweets
characters.title: Sweet Songstress
characters.notes: A winter-themed version of Diesel, the AZX attendant. Diesel: Winter Sweets is an Attacker who uses her singing and sustained damage abilities to overwhelm enemies.

characters.name: Dorothy
characters.title: Goddess of Victory
characters.notes: The leader of the Goddess squad and a Grimms Model who once fought alongside the original Goddess of Victory. Dorothy possesses immense power and carries deep resentment toward humanity after the events surrounding the Ark.

characters.name: Flora
characters.title: Botanic Gardener
characters.notes: A member of the Botanic Garden squad who specializes in plant cultivation and support. Flora continuously heals herself and nearby allies and can provide shields and True Damage support.

characters.name: Moran
characters.title: The Tiger
characters.notes: The leader of the Underworld Queen squad. Moran is a straightforward and fiercely loyal fighter who specializes in surviving heavy damage, taunting enemies, and protecting her allies.

characters.name: Snow White: Innocent Days
characters.title: Innocent Days
characters.notes: Snow White in her younger days, before becoming the hardened warrior of Pioneer. Innocent Days is a Pilgrim Attacker who fights with the Seven Dwarves weapon system.

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.title: Lycoris
characters.notes: An outstanding Lycoris from Café LycoReco who joins NIKKE through the Lycoris Recoil collaboration. Takina is a Supporter who boosts allies, weakens enemies, and can deal True Damage during Burst.

characters.name: Scarlet: Black Shadow
characters.title: Black Shadow
characters.notes: A younger and more ruthless incarnation of Scarlet. Black Shadow uses a Rocket Launcher and specializes in extremely high single-target damage, charge attacks, and distributed damage.

characters.name: Arcane
characters.title: Yinglung Special Task Force Captain
characters.notes: Captain of the Yinglung Special Task Force who is stationed at Yinglung Pass. Arcane is a serious and meticulous Nature Caster who specializes in Nature Infliction, Corrosion, crowd control, and powerful Arts damage.

characters.name: Laevatain
characters.title: The Ashen Flame
characters.notes: A Sarkaz operator from Rhodes Island who specializes in Heat damage and Combustion. Laevatain builds Melting Flame through Heat Infliction and unleashes devastating attacks during her Ultimate.

characters.name: Last Rite
characters.title: The Witch of Seš'qa
characters.notes: A Sarkaz Witch associated with Seš'qa who wields a massive Greatsword. Last Rite combines powerful Cryo damage with Cryo Infliction, Corrosion, and exceptional sustain.

characters.name: Perlica
characters.title: Supervisor of Endfield Industries
characters.notes: The Supervisor and official spokesperson of Endfield Industries. Perlica is an Electric Caster specializing in Electric Infliction and Electrification, using Techno-Protocol to deliver powerful Arts attacks.

characters.name: Zhuang Fangyi
characters.title: Wuling Tianshi
characters.notes: The Viceroy of the Wuling Scientific Developmental District and the Tianshi overseeing the Novel Xiranite-based Materials Project. Zhuang Fangyi is a Kylin and Electric Striker whose combat revolves around Electrification, Sunderblades, and her powerful Empyrean of Truth state.

characters.name: Xaihi
characters.title: The Enlightened One
characters.notes: A Sarkaz Supporter from the Cabal of Tranquility who provides healing, Cryo Infliction, and Arts Amplification. Xaihi is especially valuable in Cryo and Nature-focused teams.

characters.name: Alice
characters.title: Alice Thymefield
characters.notes: Alice Thymefield is a Physical Anomaly Agent and a member of the Spook Shack. She specializes in Assault Anomaly damage and uses Blade Etiquette to unleash powerful charged attacks.

characters.name: Astra Yao
characters.title: Star of Lyra
characters.notes: A famous singer and the first limited Support Agent in Zenless Zone Zero. Astra Yao enters Idyllic Cadenza to provide powerful teamwide buffs, healing, Quick Assists, and additional Chain Attacks.

characters.name: Miyabi
characters.title: Hoshimi Miyabi
characters.notes: The head of Hollow Special Operations Section 6 and successor to a renowned martial arts family. Miyabi is an Anomaly Agent who wields Frost, a unique form of Ice damage, and specializes in massive burst damage through Shimotsuki.

characters.name: Rimielle
characters.notes: A newly introduced S-Rank Lumiflux Anomaly Agent. Rimielle has been added to the current ZZZ character database, but detailed combat information, signature W-Engine, and full profile data are not yet available.

characters.name: Rina
characters.title: Alexandrina Sebastiane
characters.notes: The elegant maid and manager of Victoria Housekeeping Co. Rina provides powerful Electric support, PEN Ratio buffs, and off-field damage through her two Bangboo companions.

characters.name: Vivian
characters.title: Mockingbird
characters.notes: A member of Mockingbird and an Ether Anomaly Agent. Vivian specializes in Abloom damage, applying additional Ether damage based on the Anomaly damage dealt by her teammates.

characters.name: Velina
characters.notes: A Wind Anomaly Agent from the External Strategy Department. Velina primarily operates off-field, applying Wind Anomaly through Vortexes and Cyclones while reducing enemy Anomaly buildup resistance and supporting Anomaly teams.

characters.name: Ye Shunguang
characters.title: Enlightened Mind
characters.notes: An S-Rank Attack Agent belonging to Yunkui Summit. Ye Shunguang uses Qingming Sword Force and the Enlightened Mind state to deliver powerful Physical attacks with high mobility and extended invulnerability.

characters.name: Yixuan
characters.title: Grandmaster of Mysticism
characters.notes: The grandmaster of Yunkui Summit and the first Rupture Agent. Yixuan uses HP to generate Sheer Force and deals Auric Ink damage that ignores enemy DEF, making her an exceptionally powerful Ether damage dealer.

characters.name: Beryl
characters.title: The Crystal Diviner
characters.notes: A renowned crystal diviner and proprietor of Bouanich's Parlor in Paris. Beryl is the central damage dealer of the Lingering Glow archetype, converting Burn and Halo into powerful follow-up attacks and scaling her Critical Rate through Lingering Glow.

characters.name: Bkornblume
characters.title: The Berlin Bookworm
characters.notes: A mysterious and highly capable intelligence officer associated with the St. Pavlov Foundation. Bkornblume specializes in Reality damage, enemy defense reduction, damage amplification, and burst damage against debuffed targets.

characters.name: Druvis III
characters.title: The Lady of the Forest
characters.notes: A mysterious aristocratic arcanist deeply connected to nature. Druvis III specializes in Petrify, Plant-based support, damage amplification, and controlling enemies while supporting Plant allies.

characters.name: Eternity
characters.title: The Sea for Yourself
characters.notes: The mysterious owner of the arcanum shop Sea for Yourself. Eternity is a durable Mineral arcanist whose kit revolves around Nasty Wound, self-sustain, and HP manipulation. Her Euphoria transforms her into a powerful support for HP-loss and Bloodtithe teams.

characters.name: Hissabeth
characters.title: The Serpentine Scholar
characters.notes: A Plant arcanist descended from a family with powerful petrification abilities. Hissabeth commands eight mystical snakes through her Snake's Den, Serpentine Scales, and Hiss! incantations, dealing Mental and Genesis damage while applying control effects.

characters.name: Lorentz Butterfly
characters.title: The Chaos Researcher
characters.notes: A researcher associated with the Lorentz Institute and an expert in chaos theory. Lorentz Butterfly is a key support for the Lingering Glow archetype, generating Burn, manipulating Moxie, amplifying allies, and printing additional incantations through Fractal Dimension.

characters.name: Semmelweis
characters.title: The Bloodthirsty Researcher
characters.notes: A mysterious Infected arcanist with a vampire-like nature. Semmelweis sacrifices HP from herself and her allies to provide powerful offensive buffs and create the Blood Domain array, making her a core support for HP-loss and Bloodtithe teams.

characters.name: Voyager
characters.title: The Star Traveler
characters.notes: A mysterious traveler who appears to have journeyed through the stars. Voyager uses music and celestial phenomena to inflict Confusion, reduce enemy Moxie, provide defensive support, and control enemies through Silence and Seal.

characters.name: Nautika
characters.title: The Arctic Voyager
characters.notes: A Spirit Infected explorer whose journey into the Arctic transformed her body and identity. Nautika is the primary damage dealer of the Bloodtithe archetype, constantly sacrificing HP to generate Bloodtithe and consuming it for massive damage while maintaining exceptional durability.

characters.name: Alicia Blanche
characters.title: Ice Witch
characters.notes: An S-Rank Hunter and guild member of France's top guild, Justitia. Known publicly as the Ice Witch, Alicia uses powerful ice magic and specializes in Water damage.

characters.name: Amamiya Mirei
characters.notes: A young Japanese Hunter who uses Soul-Powered Swordsmanship and the mysterious Oni Kuroha sword technique. Mirei is a Wind Striker specializing in high-speed sword attacks.

characters.name: Cha Hae-In (Pure Sword Princess)
characters.title: Pure Sword Princess
characters.notes: An alternate-world version of Cha Hae-In and guild master of the Valkyrie Guild. This version specializes in Water sword techniques and uses her Defense stat to power her attacks.

characters.name: Han Se-Mi
characters.notes: A member of the Hunters Guild B-Team strike squad. Han Se-Mi is a Wind Supporter and healer who restores HP and MP while providing shields and support effects.

characters.name: Isla Wright
characters.notes: A young healer and member of the Helpers Guild. Isla relies on tarot-card abilities for healing, buffs, debuffs, and team support.

characters.name: Meilin Fisher
characters.notes: A Water Supporter from the Federal Bureau of Hunters. Meilin manipulates water and fights alongside her guardian spirit cat, Berry, providing healing, buffs, and Water damage support.

characters.name: MINNIE
characters.notes: A member of the Hunter-idol group [i-dle]. MINNIE is a Dark Striker who uses scythe techniques and butterfly-themed illusion magic to build powerful burst attacks.

characters.name: MIYEON
characters.notes: The eldest member and main vocalist of the Hunter-idol group [i-dle]. MIYEON is a Light Striker who uses a longsword and crystal magic to deal heavy damage.

characters.name: Sung Jinah
characters.notes: Sung Jinah is Sung Jinwoo's younger sister in an alternate story setting. She is a Wind Supporter who uses spear techniques and provides team support through buffs and utility.

characters.name: Tawata Kanae
characters.weapon: The Path a Hero Must Take
characters.notes: An S-Rank Hunter of the Blade Guild who dual-wields swords. Tawata Kanae is a Fire Striker who builds powerful Crimson, Scarlet, and Fire states to increase her damage.
tags: The Path a Hero Must Take

characters.name: Yoo Soohyun
characters.notes: A famous model and Yoo Jinho's cousin. Yoo Soohyun is a Fire Striker who uses otherworldly magic and ranged attacks to deal high Fire damage.

characters.name: YUQI
characters.notes: The tank and main dancer of the Hunter-idol group [i-dle]. YUQI is a Fire Breaker who uses explosive gauntlets and martial arts to deal damage and build Break.

characters.name: Laura Walker
characters.notes: A Light Supporter from the Scavenger Guild who fights using black lightning and a whip. Laura supports Light teams through damage buffs, shields, healing, and offensive pressure.

characters.name: Elena Renault
characters.notes: The vice guild master of France's top Justitia Guild. Elena is a Water Supporter who manipulates mercury to provide Water damage buffs, shields, survivability, and Winter Chill synergy.

characters.name: Meri Laine
characters.title: Iceborn Star
characters.notes: A rookie Hunter of the Richter Guild who wields a massive saw-type weapon. Meri is a Water Elemental Stacker specializing in Winter Chill, Freezing Blood, sustained damage, and Pengqueen Booster Mode.

characters.name: Super Vegito
characters.title: Ultimate Warrior of Hope
characters.notes: An ULTRA Super Vegito from the Majin Buu Saga. He is a Potara Fusion Warrior with powerful defensive abilities, Endurance, counters, and a unique ability to restore his Vanishing Gauge.

characters.name: Super Saiyan God Shallet
characters.title: Godly Fusion Warrior
characters.notes: Shallet is the fusion of Shallot and Giblet. In Super Saiyan God form, Shallet becomes a Green ranged Fusion Warrior with Element Switch, Endurance, and powerful God Ki abilities.

characters.name: Super Gogeta
characters.title: Ultimate Fusion Warrior
characters.notes: The ULTRA Super Gogeta from the Fusion Reborn movie. He is a Blue Melee Fusion Warrior who gains powerful offensive and defensive effects and uses Soul Punisher as his Ultimate Arts.

characters.name: Super Saiyan God SS Vegito
characters.title: Sapphire Protector of the Future
characters.notes: The original Blue LEGENDS LIMITED Super Saiyan God SS Vegito from the Future Trunks Saga. He is a Blue Melee Potara Fusion Warrior with powerful Ultimate Arts and Fusion Warrior support.

characters.name: Super Saiyan God SS Gogeta PUR
characters.title: Ultimate Warrior
characters.notes: The Purple ULTRA Super Saiyan God SS Gogeta from Dragon Ball Super: Broly. He is a Purple Melee Fusion Warrior with powerful Unique Gauge mechanics, counters, and the God Punisher Ultimate Arts.

characters.name: Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta
characters.title: Ultimate Fusion Warrior
characters.notes: The ULTRA Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta from Dragon Ball GT. He is a Purple Melee Fusion Warrior with an Arts Action, powerful counters, and the 100x Big Bang Kamehameha.

characters.name: Super Saiyan God SS Gogeta RED
characters.title: Angel-Born Warrior
characters.notes: The original Red LEGENDS LIMITED Super Saiyan God SS Gogeta from Dragon Ball Super: Broly. This is the Red Gogeta Blue unit, distinct from the later Purple ULTRA version.

characters.name: Vegeta & Goku → Super Vegito
characters.title: Unyielding Pride and the Fate of the Earth
characters.notes: A LEGENDS LIMITED Tag unit featuring Vegeta and Goku from the Majin Buu Saga. The pair can Tag Switch and charge a Synchro Gauge before fusing into Super Vegito with 100% health.

characters.name: Blue Goku & Vegeta → Super Saiyan God SS Gogeta
characters.title: Fateful Fusion
characters.notes: A LEGENDS LIMITED Tag unit featuring Super Saiyan God SS Goku and Vegeta from Dragon Ball Super: Broly. They use a Synchro Gauge and can fuse into Super Saiyan God SS Gogeta.

characters.name: Super Saiyan God SS Goku & Vegeta
characters.title: Blueberry Boys
characters.notes: The Purple Tag unit featuring Super Saiyan God SS Goku and Vegeta from the Broly movie. They can switch between Goku and Vegeta and provide strong offensive and defensive utility.
tags: Super Saiyan God SS Goku & Vegeta

characters.name: Super Saiyan Rosé Ultra Supervillain Goku Black
characters.title: You Will Know the Power of the Gods!
characters.notes: The LEGEND rarity Super Saiyan Rosé Ultra Supervillain Goku Black from the DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 collaboration. He is a Blue Melee Goku Black who uses a scythe and possesses Endurance, Revive Disruption, and powerful Future and God Ki abilities.

characters.name: Liv: Eclipse
characters.title: Support Frame
characters.notes: Liv's initial support frame providing team healing and physical buffs.

characters.name: Liv: Luminance
characters.title: Elite Medic
characters.notes: Liv's enhanced S-Rank support frame providing massive shields and healing.

characters.name: Liv: Empyrea
characters.title: Holy Feather
characters.notes: Liv's transcendent angel frame absorbing punishment to cleanse corruption.

characters.name: Selena: Tempest
characters.title: Capriccio Siren
characters.notes: Selena's tempestuous Uniframe weaving musical notes into lightning strikes.

characters.name: Selena: Capriccio
characters.title: Iris of Hope
characters.notes: Selena's beautiful dark amplifier frame conducting operatic death waves.

characters.name: Qu: Shukra
characters.title: Empress of Kowloong
characters.notes: The supreme empress of Kowloong wielding imperial frost blades.

characters.name: Hanying: Solacetune
characters.title: Zither Maiden
characters.notes: A serene Kowloong maiden performing soothing physical resonance tunes.

characters.name: Selena: Pianissimo
characters.title: Nocturne Sonata
characters.notes: Selena's serene ice frame channeling piano sonatas into freezing gusts.

characters.name: Jetavie: Daybreak
characters.title: Dawn Guardian
characters.notes: A powerful solar cannon frame unleashing radiant fire rays.

characters.name: Bianca: Crepuscule
characters.title: Abyssal Huntress
characters.notes: Bianca's crepuscular frame hunting corruptors in dark veil realms.

characters.name: Liv: Limpidity
characters.title: Crystal Saint
characters.notes: Liv's crystalline holy frame purifying corrupted structures with pure ice.

characters.name: Chitose
characters.title: Starlight Blade
characters.notes: A sword prodigy of Stella Sora slashing through starry dimensions.

characters.name: Wraith
characters.title: Shadow Assassin
characters.notes: A phantom assassin striking targets from veil shadows.

characters.name: Gerie
characters.title: Mechanical Genius
characters.notes: An eccentric mechanic deploying automated support turrets.

characters.name: Suntide Willow
characters.title: Solar Druid
characters.notes: An elf priestess channeling solar energy to heal allies.

characters.name: Otoha
characters.title: Soundwave Maiden
characters.notes: A musical student converting sound vibrations into shockwaves.

characters.name: Ame
characters.title: Blade Maiden
characters.notes: A skilled Japanese katana user serving Mirasha.

characters.name: Astei Demiurge
characters.title: Demiurge of Sun
characters.notes: The divine sun goddess Astei in her unleashed Demiurge form.

characters.name: Caren
characters.title: Chivalrous Knight
characters.notes: A noble knight guarding royal heirs with impenetrable water shields.

characters.name: Delta Heatwave Cop
characters.title: Summer Enforcer
characters.notes: Delta patrolling summer beaches in her heatwave cop uniform.

characters.name: Liselotte
characters.title: Gothic Maid
characters.notes: A gothic maid wielding a giant scythe with deadly grace.

characters.name: Nadja
characters.title: Desert Assassin
characters.notes: A desert nomad assassin striking targets under sandstorms.

characters.name: Herrscher of the Void
characters.title: Battlesuit: Herrscher of the Void
characters.notes: Kiana's awakened Herrscher of Void form controlling subspace portals and void spears.

characters.name: Void Drifter

characters.notes: Sirin in a magical girl universe weaving burning scissors chakram spells.

characters.name: Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer
characters.title: Battlesuit: Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer
characters.notes: The Shu of Hedonism from Langqiu on Mars wielding ice whip blades.

characters.name: Lone Planetfarer
characters.title: Battlesuit: Lone Planetfarer
characters.notes: The enigmatic wanderer traveling through planetary ruins in the Sea of Quanta.

characters.name: Chiori
characters.title: The Thundering Seamstress
characters.notes: A renowned fashion designer from Inazuma who established Chioriya Boutique in Fontaine. Chiori specializes in creating elegant and distinctive clothing while maintaining a sharp and straightforward personality.

characters.name: Columbina
characters.title: Moon Maiden
characters.notes: Known as the Moon Maiden, Columbina is a mysterious character associated with Frost Moon and the Three Moons. She was formerly one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and now plays an important role in Nod-Krai's lunar-related phenomena.

characters.name: Keqing
characters.title: Driving Thunder
characters.notes: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing strongly believes in taking action through her own efforts rather than relying entirely on the guidance of the gods. She is known for her efficiency, determination, and dedication to Liyue.

characters.name: Skirk
characters.title: Void Star
characters.notes: A mysterious swordswoman from the sea of stars and Tartaglia's former master. Skirk is the disciple of Surtalogi, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, and is associated with the Cosmic Calamity. Her origins are not officially assigned to a specific nation.

characters.name: Diluc
characters.title: The Dark Side of Dawn
characters.notes: The owner of the Dawn Winery and one of Mondstadt's most powerful figures. After losing his father, Diluc became a vigilante who protects Mondstadt from threats while operating from the shadows.

characters.name: Roslyn
characters.title: The Dedicated Special Officer
characters.notes: A dedicated new special officer of the Federation with a strong sense of responsibility. Roslyn strives to become an enthusiastic, approachable, and competent model officer while caring deeply for her friends.

characters.name: Yan Miao
characters.title: The Yuheng of Department of Yuheng
characters.notes: A young researcher who became the head of the Department of Yuheng. Yan Miao has made outstanding achievements in researching Darkness and strives to restore the department's reputation.

characters.name: Fei Se
characters.title: The Darkshadow
characters.notes: A powerful Flame Simulacrum associated with Endless Bloom. Fei Se uses flower-based abilities and Mirage Fantasy mechanics to create Phantasias and Lotus Petals while dealing sustained Flame damage.

characters.name: Fiona
characters.title: The Archon of Innars
characters.notes: The current Archon of the undersea city Innars. Fiona is calm, highly perceptive, and exceptionally capable of devising strategies during crises. Her Moonstar Bracelet is an Altered Support weapon capable of supporting multiple resonance types.

characters.name: Lin
characters.title: The Mirroria Idol
characters.notes: A renowned Executor of Mirroria and a highly respected figure among its residents. Lin is known for her strict standards, cleanliness, and strong sense of responsibility. She was the first Simulacrum to wield Altered Damage.
